summary: NewHold Investment Corp IV filed an 8-K to disclose the consummation of its initial public offering on April 16, 2026, of 20,125,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $201.25 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing also reports standard IPO-related agreements. This is a routine current report of a SPAC's IPO closing, not a special-situation event like a business combination or liquidation.
